svg.title: Compare Contribution Yield Before Adding Fixed Overhead
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-subniche-contribution-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Contribution Yield Before Adding Fixed Overhead; subtitle: Five illustrative sub-niche and payment-rail combinations.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are contribution percentages of recognized retail sales after refunds, not annual net margins. Each example uses a $100 recognized-sales basis and subtracts landed goods, fulfillment including return handling, payment costs, and acquisition. Fixed labor and overhead remain excluded.; caption: These are underwriting examples, not observed category benchmarks. Payment costs vary by provider, transaction mix, disputes, and contract; validate the complete order economics.; stages: label: Authorized replacement filters through card checkout; value: 28% contribution; $28 retained per $100 sales; numeric value: 28.0; detail: $100 less $42 landed goods, $12 fulfillment, $3 payment costs, and $15 acquisition leaves $28. Verify compatibility claims and prevent obsolete-model stock accumulation.; label: Compact repair accessories through card checkout; value: 24% contribution; $24 retained per $100 sales; numeric value: 24.0; detail: $100 less $48 landed goods, $9 fulfillment, $3 payment costs, and $16 acquisition leaves $24. This cost mix matches Base contribution before fixed overhead.; label: Bulky organization products through card checkout; value: 16% contribution; $16 retained per $100 sales; numeric value: 16.0; detail: $100 less $45 landed goods, $20 fulfillment, $3 payment costs, and $16 acquisition leaves $16. Measure dimensional-weight surcharges and damage-driven reverse logistics.; label: Premium accessories through installment-provider checkout; value: 22% contribution; $22 retained per $100 sales; numeric value: 22.0; detail: $100 less $47 landed goods, $10 fulfillment, $6 payment costs, and $15 acquisition leaves $22. Test incremental retained purchases rather than assuming financing lifts profit.; label: Repeat business replenishment through ACH checkout; value: 36% contribution; $36 retained per $100 sales; numeric value: 36.0; detail: $100 less $48 landed goods, $10 fulfillment, $1 payment costs, and $5 acquisition leaves $36. Validate authorization, settlement timing, return exposure, and repeat demand.

text.title: Authorized replacement filters through card checkout

circle.title: label: Authorized replacement filters through card checkout; value: 28% contribution; $28 retained per $100 sales; numeric value: 28.0; detail: $100 less $42 landed goods, $12 fulfillment, $3 payment costs, and $15 acquisition leaves $28. Verify compatibility claims and prevent obsolete-model stock accumulation.

circle.title: label: Compact repair accessories through card checkout; value: 24% contribution; $24 retained per $100 sales; numeric value: 24.0; detail: $100 less $48 landed goods, $9 fulfillment, $3 payment costs, and $16 acquisition leaves $24. This cost mix matches Base contribution before fixed overhead.
